{{Top|leg}}
'''I-9''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] that was located near to the center of the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Darkstaff]], a powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifact had came to be located within I-9, and in circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Len Markus]] traveled to the asteroid and seized the Darkstaff.
